sources.relevant_excerpt: Nationals of countries listed in Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 do not require a visa for short-stay visits (27 of these countries have visa waiver agreements with the EU). Nationals of countries in Annex I of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 must obtain a visa. They can enter Schengen area countries as many times as they want, but only stay for a total of 90 days, every 180 days. Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 establishes the legal framework for visa policy across Schengen countries.

sources.search_query: Applying for a Schengen visa home-affairs europa passport validity fee
sources.relevant_excerpt: Citizens of certain non-EU countries must hold a short-stay visa when travelling to the Schengen area. Submit your application at the consulate of your primary destination country. You may stay up to 90 days within any 180-day period. Your passport must remain valid for at least three months beyond your scheduled departure from the Schengen zone. Standard fees: EUR 90 (adults), EUR 45 (children 6-12), EUR 35 (Armenian, Azerbaijani, Belarusian nationals), EUR 67.50 (Cape Verdean nationals). Processing typically takes 15 days.

policies.policy_name: Schengen short-stay visa exemption (Annex II, Regulation (EU) 2018/1806)
policies.description: Nationals of third countries listed in Annex II of Regulation (EU) 2018/1806 are exempt from the short-stay visa requirement for the Schengen area, including Greece, for stays of no more than 90 days in any 180-day period. List includes (non-exhaustive): Andorra, United Arab Emirates, Antigua and Barbuda, Argentina, Australia, Barbados, Brunei, Brazil, Bahamas, Canada, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, Guatemala, Honduras, Israel, Japan, Saint Kitts and Nevis, South Korea, Monaco, Mauritius, Mexico, Malaysia, New Zealand, Panama, Paraguay, Singapore, San Marino, El Salvador, Trinidad and Tobago, United States, Uruguay, Holy See, Venezuela, Samoa; plus Hong Kong SAR and Macao SAR passport holders, British citizens (via Reg 2019/592), and Taiwan passport holders whose passports include an identity-card number.
conditions: Some exemptions are limited to biometric-passport holders or subject to specific passport types (Hong Kong/Macao/Taiwan)
